title: Annual leave entitlement
text: Permanent employees accrue 2 days of paid annual leave per month worked (24 days per year). Fixed-term employees accrue pro rata. Interns receive 1 day per month. Leave requests must be submitted in the HR portal at least 10 working days in advance and approved by the line manager.

title: Carry-over of annual leave
text: Up to 5 unused annual leave days may be carried over to the next year and must be used before 31 March. Days above this limit are lost unless HR approves an exception in writing.

title: Sick leave
text: Employees must inform their manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required from the third consecutive day of sick leave and must be uploaded to the HR portal within 48 hours.

title: Pay dates
text: Salaries are paid on the 25th of each month, or the previous working day if the 25th falls on a weekend or public holiday. Payslips are available in the HR portal from the 24th.

title: Changing bank details
text: Bank detail changes must be requested through an HR ticket and verified by phone by the payroll team. Changes received after the 15th apply from the following month.

title: Employment certificates
text: HR issues certificates of employment and salary certificates within 3 working days of a ticket request. Urgent requests linked to a documented deadline (for example a visa appointment) are prioritised. Certificates are signed by the HR manager and can be collected at HR or sent as a signed PDF.

title: Remote work
text: Employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week with manager approval. Remote days must be recorded in the HR portal. Company VPN must be used for all internal systems when working remotely.

title: Health insurance and benefits
text: Permanent and fixed-term employees are covered by the group health insurance from their first day. Meal vouchers of 8 per working day are credited monthly. Interns are eligible for meal vouchers but not group insurance.

title: Reporting concerns
text: Concerns about harassment, discrimination or misconduct can be reported confidentially to the HR manager or through the anonymous ethics channel. Reports are handled confidentially and retaliation against anyone raising a concern in good faith is prohibited.
